summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem has become the de facto standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services via a unified JSON-RPC interface. By 2026 the ecosystem spans three layers: aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations behind one endpoint, gateways/proxies that add auth, rate-limiting and observability, and thousands of individual MCP servers for specific tools. This standardization matters because it lets any AI agent discover and invoke capabilities—browsers, repos, databases, design files—without bespoke integrations.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (Composio, Smithery, mcp.so) expose many tools through one managed endpoint, gateways (agentgateway, Cloudflare, Kong) sit in front of servers to handle auth/security/routing, and individual servers (Playwright, GitHub, Figma) each connect an agent to one specific tool or platform.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation via Playwright—navigation, clicks, form fills, and accessibility-tree snapshots (25+ tools) across Chrome, Firefox, and WebKit
strengths: Highest search volume of any MCP server (~35,000/mo)
No vision models or screenshots needed—uses accessibility tree
Fast and LLM-friendly with excellent compatibility
tools.best_for: AI-driven browser automation, end-to-end testing, and web scraping

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Figma design files—extracting layout, components, and design tokens for AI-assisted design-to-code workflows
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Figma plans; Dev Mode requires paid seats
strengths: Bridges design and code for AI agents
tools.best_for: Design-to-code generation and pulling design context into AI coding agents

tools.name: GitHub MCP
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories—issues, pull requests, code search, CI, and repo automation
tools.pricing_paid: Free; follows GitHub plan pricing for private/org features
strengths: Backs the GitHub MCP Registry for discovering/vetting servers
Default choice for repo automation workflows
tools.best_for: Repository automation, issue triage, and PR workflows for AI agents

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 1,500+ apps through a single managed MCP endpoint (Slack, GitHub, Gmail, databases, Filesystem, Playwright, etc.) with managed auth and self-learning tool selection
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers beyond free quota (team/enterprise plans)
strengths: 1B+ tool calls run on the platform
Self-learning layer improves tool selection and token efficiency
Repeat tasks run ~30% more accurately on 2× fewer tokens
tools.best_for: Teams wanting one managed endpoint for hundreds of integrations without building each connector

tools.name: Context7
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples injected into AI coding prompts
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid via Upstash usage plans
strengths: Remote server, easy to add to any IDE
Widely adopted in AI coding setups
tools.best_for: Feeding current, accurate documentation to AI coding assistants

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Supabase Postgres databases, auth, storage, and edge functions for AI agents
tools.pricing_paid: Follows Supabase plan pricing (Pro and above)
strengths: Great fit for full-stack AI app development
tools.best_for: AI agents managing databases and backend services on Supabase

tools.name: Notion MCP
tools.connects_to: Notion workspaces—pages, databases, and documents for reading and writing knowledge
strengths: Popular for knowledge-base and docs automation
tools.best_for: AI agents reading and updating Notion docs and databases

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: n8n workflow automation—triggering and orchestrating multi-step workflows across 400+ integrations from AI agents
tools.pricing_paid: Free self-hosted (fair-code); n8n Cloud paid plans
strengths: Bridges AI agents with powerful workflow automation
tools.best_for: Connecting AI agents to automated, multi-step business workflows

tools.name: Zapier MCP
tools.connects_to: 7,000+ apps via Zapier's automation platform exposed as MCP actions
tools.pricing_paid: Zapier paid plans for higher task volume and premium apps
strengths: Largest app catalog of any automation platform
No-code setup for massive integration breadth
tools.best_for: Giving AI agents access to thousands of SaaS apps without custom code

tools.name: Jira MCP
tools.connects_to: Jira issues, projects, and workflows for AI-driven ticketing and project management
tools.best_for: AI agents managing issues, sprints, and project workflows in Jira

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: A registry and hosting marketplace of thousands of MCP servers, with one-click deploy and hosted endpoints
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting tiers for private/managed servers
strengths: Central hub for the MCP ecosystem
tools.best_for: Discovering, deploying, and hosting MCP servers from one marketplace

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosting and securing remote MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth, routing, and observability
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans for higher usage and compute
tools.best_for: Deploying and securing remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers via Docker MCP Catalog and Toolkit—running servers in isolated containers with centralized management
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Business/Team plans for enterprise features
strengths: Secure, isolated execution of MCP servers in containers
Curated MCP Catalog for trusted servers
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely in isolated containers with centralized management

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: A community directory indexing thousands of MCP servers and clients for discovery
strengths: Fast discovery of new and niche servers
Popular entry point for MCP newcomers
tools.best_for: Browsing and discovering the full range of available MCP servers
